Probe: scratchpad bin, jmap-chat-client + base-client @ c59916d8, NoneAuth, fetch_session + Chat/get (+ connect_ws_session/next_frame with --features ws). Profile: opt-level=z, lto=true, codegen-units=1, panic=abort, strip. Target aarch64-linux-android (NDK 28.2.13676358, API 24). Stripped sizes: HTTP-only 1,846,360 B; HTTP+WS 1,980,984 B (+134,624 B; .text 986,736 -\u003e 1,083,248). HTTP-only .text by crate (cargo-bloat 0.12.1, 964 KiB total): std 252K, rustls 185K, reqwest 95K, ring 87K, hyper_util 30K, http 28K, webpki 27K, tokio 26K, jmap_chat_client 21K, url 21K, serde_json 20K, idna 15K, jmap_did_types 8.7K, jmap_base_client 4.8K. .rodata 457,812 B, .eh_frame 181,076 B. FINDINGS: (a) LTO already removes all tungstenite code from apps that never call WS: a ws feature saves 0 B for them; it only drops ~8 build-only crates (tokio-tungstenite, tungstenite, sha1, rand, rand_chacha, ppv-lite86, data-encoding, zerocopy) of 138 in base-client normal tree. (b) SSE has no unique deps (reqwest stream + in-crate parser): gating saves nothing; not justified. (c) TLS: rustls+ring+webpki ~300K .text plus roots in .rodata is the dominant cost; only one backend exists, so a 'choice' means adding native-tls or rustls-platform-verifier (new code, conflicts with rustls-first stance bd:JMAP-sc1b.89). (d) did-types (ed25519-dalek/k256/p256/idna) costs 8.7K in binary after LTO; compile-time only; keep. (e) aarch64-apple-ios not measurable on this Linux host (no Xcode SDK/ld64). (f) A CI size budget needs NDK in CI. No code changed; needs Mark's decision."}
